tests.name: Finite seed alone cannot become generated funds
A physically consistent liquidity-bound earmark leaves 20, not 100
Reservation, liability accrual and payment preserve the same available amount
Historical addback requires a paid opening liability
An opening historical bill paid after receipts is not certified seed provenance
Setup and first adoption remain recovered prospective costs
Receipts after service cannot fund earlier in-horizon construction
Unpriced failed discovery stays unknown and no second investment is created

preservedCounterexample: A draft earmark subtraction only in the generated bound overcommitted a liquidity-bound budget. This was corrected before any fresh campaign. The verified physically consistent control has cash600, reserve500, generated500 and earmark80; spendable amount20.
interpretation: Checks the declared attribution convention and nonmutation; does not identify unknown discovery cost, validate buyer demand or qualify a second asset.
